_meta.description: A film camera that lives in your phone — honest rolls, real develop times, full-resolution lab scans, movie reels, and an envelope worth waiting for. $7.99, once.
_title: Revela — Shoot film. Wait for it.
a-film-camera-that.280536: A film camera that lives in your phone — not a filter, a whole ritual. This is the studio. The fridge is stocked. Go ahead, open it.
a-viewfinder-a-wind.1bc80d: A viewfinder, a wind lever, a frame counter. Every frame counts because you can't see a single one of them yet.
airplay-your-finished-rolls.0b938a: AirPlay your finished rolls to the TV as a true second screen: slide-carousel clunks, projector fan hum, the whole family gathered around.
cine-stocks-load-as.ebd060: Cine stocks load as fixed-length reels at 24 fps — or a Super-8-style 18 — developed frame by frame with optional warm vinyl-character sound.
drag-the-strip-there.71b2e2: drag the strip — there are eight frames on this roll
every-stock-is-built.658f10: Every stock is built from per-film characteristic curves, layered grain, halation, and bloom — developed from RAW into full-resolution lab scans. The best of film, not a low-effort rendition of it.
film-keeps-best-in.307a37: FILM KEEPS BEST IN THE FRIDGE!
finished-prints-land-in.ef4449: Finished prints land in your Photos library at full resolution. RAW-first pipeline, per-stock color science, honest grain.
flip-a-box-over.0e1cd8: flip a box over — the good stuff is on the back
honest-mode-means-no.e79938: Honest Mode means no preview, no switching stocks mid-roll, and a real wait while the lab does its work. That's not a limitation — that's the whole point.
it-s-addressed-to.2ecd0a: it's addressed to you — tap to break the seal
keep-shooting-and-a.654666: Keep shooting and a red glow appears at the end of the hall. Behind that door is a safelight darkroom where you develop photos from your own library into any stock — trays, agitation, and prints on the line.
not-mockup-theatre-this.b8c835: Not mockup theatre — this is the actual app: the studio you walk around in, the fridge you raid, the finder you shoot blind through, and the envelope that finally lands.
pick-a-box-from.a4c7ab: Pick a box from the humming mint fridge. Tear the foil, drop the canister in, thread the leader. No peeking now.
reels-projector-nights-a.3c296b: Reels, projector nights, a living studio
revela-lab-1-safelight.34f659: REVELA LAB · 1 SAFELIGHT WAY · DARKROOM COUNTY, F/8
rewind-drop-the-canister.771dc3: Rewind, drop the canister in the mailer, and wait like everyone used to. Rush it in an hour — or send it away for days.
shelves-of-photo-boxes.f6d24b: Shelves of photo boxes down a corridor, a calendar with reveal days circled in pen, a radio that plays, plants that grow the more you shoot — and a dog underfoot, eventually a cat on the shelf.
tap-the-fridge-film.01145f: tap the fridge — film keeps best in there
when-your-roll-comes.fa1163: When your roll comes home it's addressed to you — stamped, postmarked, sealed. This is the moment the whole app is built around.
your-envelope-lands-on.164dc2: Your envelope lands on the shelf. Flip it, pull the seal, and meet your photographs for the very first time.
your-photographs-never-leave.3a9b62: Your photographs never leave your devices. No account, no server, no tracking — just you, a fridge full of film, and the mail.
